items.title: Vedanta earns record profit in Q4, plans to reduce debt
items.description: Vedanta anticipates a strong FY27 driven by record profits. The company plans to significantly reduce debt, invest in expansion, and continue rewarding shareholders. Leverage is projected to reach a new low. Vedanta is also proceeding with its demerger, with four new companies set to list soon. Some businesses are expected to be debt-free post-demerger.

items.title: Bajaj Finance Q4 net rises 22%, AUM crosses Rs 5 lakh crore
items.description: Bajaj Finance reported a robust consolidated net profit of ₹5,464.6 crore for Q4FY26, a 22% year-on-year increase driven by a 20% rise in net interest income and 22% AUM growth. In a separate announcement, Rajiv Bajaj will step down from the company's board after the annual general meeting on July 30.
